svg.text: Terrain editor — the user-friendly way (CE-4594) · revised
DESIGN_Terrain_Editor_UX.md §5 (R-5032, R-4264, the review §8) · A toolbar · B trees · C walls, snap, gate · D obstacles · E Details · F handles. Grey = annotation.
A Toolbars (TE-19, R-5038): one shared strip — a row docked on top, a column docked at the side; the main toolbar's split icon
the split icon: the face toggles the last toolbar,
▾ lists every toolbar, ✓ = open — ONE shared widget,
Layers: its own toggle (a panel, not a toolbar)
docked at the side ⇒ a COLUMN;
a family is ONE icon showing its
last variant; its menu opens beside it
Hedge — 3 drawn · click the first point of the next
Esc drops this shape · Esc again stops the tool
each repeat gets a new seed
TE-2: a terrain line / area tool stays armed after Finish,

g.text: B Trees — one, a row, a group (TE-3); a Row and a Group are ONE feature each (TE-4: kinds 14, 15)
Row of 16 trees · 8 m apart · 124 m
③ Group — an area: 11 lone trees
Trees — click to add a point
the draw panel as built: 260 px,
they fell, burn and block like
any lone tree (B-6) — not a WOOD
C Walls — along a road and onto a hedge's end (snap, TE-6); round a plot with a gate (TE-7)
Wall 320 m · brick 2 m · snapped: road edge +1 m
Ctrl: no snap · Shift: 15° · Enter ends
still ONE wall: the gate moves
the line's start into the gap
Wall — click to add a point
snap is ON for LINE tools only
Kind offers the wall family only:
a line never becomes a point
D Obstacles are ENTITIES (TE-5, R-4264): one, or a row = one undo, one group · street clutter stays baked (TE-13)
Sandbag wall × 12 · a row, end to end — one group
4 concrete blocks · 1.5 m gaps · one undo · the road CLOSES
SUMO re-routes · a tank crushes · the bulldozer clears
Obstacles — drag a line for a row
the types are the ONE ClutterTypes
table: a baked item and the obstacle
of the same name are one box
E One Details tab for every feature (TE-8)
320 m · 1 gate · stops every vehicle; a tank breaks it (B-3) · blasts breach it (B-2)
F Handles (TE-9) · the ghost stays until the bake lands (TE-10)
a placed tree: a handle dot, picked by a click
a Row: selected as ONE (its outline)
just finished: the ghost holds until the bake
takes it (≈ 5 s warm) — it never blinks out
